images.caption: Rampart at Burghead One of the remaining features of the promontory fort at Burghead. Little remains of what was an important Pictish stronghold. The distinctive bull carvings associated with the fort suggest a high status location. The white building (top left) now incorporates a small visitor centre.

images.caption: Burghead Pictish Fort Burghead's renowned whitewashed Pictish Fort which sits upon the end of Burghead Peninsula. Many Pictish artefacts have been found here in recent years and many visit the unique landmark. Viewed here from the South.
